Grand Junction CyclePaths Rides

Grand Junction, CO · Mountain bike · Road

No-dropUnconfirmed — check with the host

Grand Junction CyclePaths Rides is a mountain bike and road group ride in Grand Junction, CO. Schedule: Member-led rides most weeks, posted ad hoc on Meetup; days and times vary (morning starts, 8:00–9:00 am, are typical). Pace: friendly; no-drop unless noted.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: friendly; no-drop unless noted. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Grand Junction CyclePaths Rides group ride

An 880-member Meetup club that rides mountain and road at friendly levels around Grand Junction and Fruita. Rides are posted by members rather than on a fixed weekly slot. Unless a listing says otherwise, they are no-drop.
